_how_to_edit: Encounter weights are relative: they don't need to add up to 100, a bigger number just means more often. Set one to 0 to switch it off. 'extras' are independent chances from 0 to 1 per case (0.25 = one case in four). Save the file and the next case uses the new values. 'review': a topic whose last case scored below weak_below (0.7 = 70%) comes back once after_days have passed since that case. 'order': "unseen_first" works through every unseen topic before reviews; "review_first" puts due reviews ahead of unseen topics.
